title: Persuasion from Within: Model-Based Insider Attacks in Multi-Agent LLM Debate and Consensus
abstract: arXiv:2611.28660v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems for collective decision-making, such as multi-agent debate and consensus games, in which agents exchange messages and update their answers over multiple rounds and a resolution mechanism aggregates them into a final outcome. Most multi-agent LLM frameworks assume that every participant shares the system objective. In practice, however, a malicious agent can join as a legitimate member of the group and persuade the other agents toward a hidden adversarial goal. We formalize such attacks as a sequential decision-making problem in which the insider seeks to degrade the utility of the collective outcome. We propose a model-based insider attack that learns to persuade a group of agents: the insider first learns a world model of the benign agents from offline trajectories and then uses it both to train a persuasion policy and to plan its messages. In two case studies

translated_title: 来自内部的说服：多智能体LLM辩论与共识中的基于模型的内部攻击
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署于用于集体决策的多智能体系统中，例如多智能体辩论和共识博弈，其中各智能体在多轮交互中交换信息并更新自己的答案，再由一个决议机制将它们聚合为最终结果。大多数多智能体LLM框架假设每个参与者都共享系统目标。然而在实践中，一个恶意智能体可以作为群体的合法成员加入，并说服其他智能体朝向一个隐藏的对抗性目标。我们将这类攻击形式化为一个序贯决策问题，其中内部攻击者（insider）试图降低集体结果的效用。我们提出了一种基于模型的内部攻击方法，使其学会说服一组智能体：内部攻击者首先从离线轨迹中学习良性智能体的世界模型，然后利用该世界模型来训练说服策略并规划其发送的消息。在两个案例研究中……
tldr: 本文首次将多智能体LLM辩论与共识系统中的“内部人攻击”形式化为序贯决策问题，提出一种基于模型的方法：内部攻击者先从离线轨迹学习良性智能体的世界模型，再据此训练说服策略并规划消息，从而暗中降低集体决策结果的效用。
en_tdlr: The paper formalizes insider attacks in multi-agent LLM debate and consensus systems as a sequential decision-making problem and proposes a model-based attack in which the insider first learns a world model of benign agents from offline trajectories, then uses it to train a persuasion policy and plan messages that covertly degrade the collective outcome.
